articles.headline: Crystal Dunn 'at peace' as USWNT legend honored before Spain game
articles.description: World Cup champion and former United States women's national team defender Crystal Dunn was honored prior to Saturday's game with Spain following her January retirement.

articles.headline: Chicago Stars sign Zambia star Racheal Kundananji from Bay FC
articles.description: Bay FC has transferred forward Racheal Kundananji to Chicago Stars FC for $700,000 in intraleague transfer funds in the first major move for Chicago since the team hired Vlatko Andonovski as chief soccer officer.
